titles: What If Naruto Read ONE More Line Of The Forbidden Scroll? — Part 4
The Kazekage Signed Wrong — And Naruto Noticed
Naruto Stopped The Konoha Invasion With Paperwork | Part 4 Finale
description:
The Kazekage's signature changed. Naruto filed the old letter next to the new one, and the Chunin Exam stopped being a tournament.

A full-cast Naruto What-If audio drama (AI voices). In the season finale, a failing exam applicant with seven attempts, a forest full of scout clones, forty sparring partners for Sasuke and a very badly made cage lead Naruto to one envelope from the Hidden Sand, one old letter filed under S, and a question for the Third Hokage about who ought to be sitting in that chair. The final is not the match anyone expected, and the paperwork that follows goes looking for a missing shelf. He does not get stronger. He gets to read first.
